## Purpose
`/logs/execution/$executionId`: a workflow execution's trace, addressed by execution id. It is linked from the run pages.

## Responsibilities
`ExecutionTracePage` reads `observabilityApi.executionTrace` and renders it with `TraceDetailPage`. Titled "Execution Trace — Agentic AI Design Patterns".

## Key elements
`ExecutionTracePage`.

- **Backend:** `/api/observability/executions/{id}`.

None.

## Nuances and gotchas
The trace id is derived deterministically from the execution id on the backend.
